thread:
leo: Onboarding snag — the Console quickstart shows 'Initializing...' forever after I paste my key and click 'Run'. No error text, just spinner. Anyone seen this?

devex-bot: infra-scan: quickstart-service healthy. No 5xx seen in recent logs for sample run.

anya: Can you run a curl and share the response code? Also is that a user key or a service key?

leo: curl gave me 402 and body: {"error":"billing_required","message":"Activate billing for workspace ws_leo to make requests"} Browser console shows "TypeError: Failed to fetch" and the UI keeps retrying.

sam: That makes sense — invited workspaces end up with billing disabled and I've seen the quickstart sample treat 4xx like transient and retry forever. We'll update the sample to stop retrying on 4xx and show a billing modal. For now, a workaround is to create a service key (Org -> API keys) or add billing if you have admin rights.

leo: I used a service key and it worked, first call returned 200.

devex-bot: ticket created: DEVEX-429 "quickstart: detect billing_required and surface CTA". UX task UX-100 created to ensure billing CTA is visible for invited orgs.

anya: Follow-ups: tiny sample fix to check resp.status === 402 and show modal; SDK change to surface BillingRequiredError so apps can branch on it instead of status codes. Sam, can you own the sample PR?

sam: Yep, I'll open PRs for sample + SDK mapping today. Also adding telemetry event quickstart.billing_402 to measure occurrence.

leo: Thanks all — happy to verify the fix once merged. :thumbsup:
